title: Prep Notes, Week 4
dek: Justin Jefferson is doubtful, so Jordan Addison is the Minnesota receiver to play, and Nico Collins is off the report.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Friday's reports are in. Six fantasy starters are out, Justin Jefferson is doubtful, and eight more are questionable. Every one of them has the call below, and the two true game-time decisions are at the bottom for Sunday morning.

PPR scoring. Order Up has the inactives as each window's reports drop.

report.read: A grade 2 strain with a three to four week timeline. Tyson Bagent starts vs NYJ.
report.verdict: Pivot to Jared Goff, QB8 for me this week.

report.read: A dislocated thumb, out at least three weeks.
report.verdict: Pivot to C.J. Stroud, QB14 for me, a borderline start vs DAL.

report.read: On IR Thursday; Week 8 is the earliest return.
report.verdict: Pivot to Alvin Kamara, RB25 for me, a high-end flex play vs ATL.

report.read: Three straight missed practices and a week-to-week timeline.
report.verdict: Pivot to Braelon Allen, RB21 for me this week, an RB2 @CHI.

report.read: He did not practice all week.
report.verdict: Out. Play any WR3 on the Menu in his place.

report.read: A sprained MCL, week to week, not on IR.
report.verdict: Pivot to Juwan Johnson, TE7 for me this week.

report.read: A limited Friday after two missed days; doubtful players sit far more often than they play.
report.verdict: Plan without him. Pivot to Jordan Addison, who drew 9 targets at TB after Jefferson left.

report.read: A full Friday after two limited days is the tell; the designation is a formality.
report.verdict: WR12 for me, borderline WR1/WR2 this week vs DAL.
report.watch: the early inactives at 11:30 AM ET

report.read: The same pattern as last week, when he played every snap he was healthy for.

report.verdict: WR14 for me, borderline WR1/WR2 this week @PHI.

report.read: The same practice week as last week, when he drew a team-high 10 targets.

report.read: Two full days to end the week.

report.read: A limited Friday in London after two missed days. A true game-time call.
